FAT ENEMIES - drop-in
1. Install BepInExPack_Valheim first (thunderstore.io, or via r2modman).
2. Drag the BepInEx folder from here into your Valheim folder (merge when asked).
   Result: Valheim/BepInEx/plugins/FatEnemies.dll
3. Launch Valheim. Settings appear in BepInEx/config/com.example.fatenemies.cfg after the first run.
